'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|I've heard there's trouble brewing at the chemical plant these days. Looters are crawling all over the place, carrying off anything they can get their hands on. And I know every inch of that place. I worked security there myself for half a year, before TerraGroup showed up. None of this sits right with me. Those bandits need to be taught a lesson. Make them forget the road to that factory, if only for a little while.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 6 PMС operatives on [[Factory]]

==Rewards==
* +28,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.75'''</font>
* 275,000 Roubles
** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Well done! There's no shortage of scum in Tarkov, and others will come soon enough. But next time, they'll think twice before helping themselves to what isn't theirs.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill 6 PMСs anywhere on [[Factory]]
